verdict.rationale: mise ships a registry of shorthand tool names (e.g. `mise use aws-cli` mapping to aqua:aws/aws-cli). It also installs from many backends: aqua and GitHub releases ('almost all programs available on GitHub'), npm, PyPI via pipx, its own Homebrew implementation, plain HTTP URLs, and asdf/vfox plugins. Registry data can be refreshed independently of the mise binary, and community users confirm it supports many more package sources and languages than alternatives. Missing for 10: no documented registry size or maintenance cadence, and no independent measure of how well-maintained the registry entries are.
